content: भवनम् [भू-आधारे ल्युट्] .²1 Being, existence. .²2 Production, birth. .²3 An abode, residence, dwelling, mansion; अथवा भवनप्रत्ययात् प्रविष्टोऽस्मि <ls>Mk. 3</ls>; <ls>Me. 34</ls>; <ls>Rām. 7. 11. 50</ls>. .²4 A site, abode, receptacle; as in अविनयभवनम् <ls>Pt. 1. 191</ls>. .²5 A building. .²6 A field; स शालिभवनं रम्यं सर्वसस्यसमाचितम् <ls>Mb. 5. 84. 15</ls>. .²7 Nature. .²8 Horoscope, natal star. .{@-नः@} A dog.
